newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on Pudong shares fall.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on Pudong shares fall.

text.p: Shanghai B Shares ended down in slow trade on Wednesday on Pudong shares falling with most investors remaining sidelined, brokers said.
The index fell 0.430 points or 0.84 percent to 50.588 points, on volume of 7.8 million shares worth $2.8 million. Of 41 B shares, 32 traded, with 15 down, 11 flat and six up.
Brokers said that heavy overseas selling in Pudong shares depressed the market.
"Shanghai Lujiazui Financial & Trade Zone Development has begun to fall as institutional support decreases," one broker said.
Shanghai Lujiazui ended down $0.012 or 1.30 percent to $0.910 on volume of 464,600 shares.
"Technical charts showed the market has fallen into the downward channel, and it will test the 50-point support level in short term," one trader said.
Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development, another Pudong share, was the worst performer, falling $0.022 or 5.91 percent to $0.350 on volume of 42,700 shares.
Shanghai Phoenix traded the most, falling $0.002 or 1.61 percent to $0.122 on volume of 2.6 million shares.
Shanghai A shares ended up on a technical rebound, but market sentiment was weaker due to the recent faster pace of market expansion, brokers said.
The A index gained 5.359 points or 0.67 percent to 803.830 points, on volume of 231.2 million shares worth 2.0 billion yuan.
The SSE 30 rose 6.122 points or 0.30 percent to 2066.359 points.
Ningbo Hualian was the star on speculation by one institution, jumping 1.40 yuan or 10.23 percent to 15.08 yuan on volume of 1.7 million shares.
